title: pdf_manifest.json — pinned-revision manifest for blank source PDFs
description: The shared manifest dialect read by maine_forms_engine.drift (check_upstream / fetch_pdfs) and maine_forms_engine.fill.verify. Each form's blank PDF is pinned to the exact revision its mapping/schema/field inventory was built against, by SHA-256 and byte size, with the official URL to re-fetch it. The repos do not redistribute the blanks; this manifest is what makes an on-demand fetch provably the same document. NOTE: maine-corporation-forms currently ships a forked dialect ({"pdfs": [...]}); converging it onto this shape is its migration step.

count.description: Optional convenience count of entries in "forms".

endpoint_pattern.description: Optional URL template the per-form urls were derived from (e.g. a portal's parametrized download endpoint with a {} placeholder).

url.description: Official source URL the blank is fetched from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the pinned blank-PDF revision.

bytes.description: Byte size of the pinned revision (cheap pre-hash check).

num_pages.description: Optional page count of the pinned revision.

has_acroform.description: Optional: whether the pinned revision carries AcroForm widgets.
